hero_description: Discover new words with Wordistan, create your personal dictionaries, and experience lasting learning with effective games.
mkt_subtitle: With Wordistan's practical features, don't just memorize words; master them with fun and reinforcement.
mkt_dict_desc: Build unlimited dictionaries tailored to your interests and level, organize words, share with friends, and access anytime.
mkt_games_desc: Play word games with your custom dictionaries to reinforce what you've learned and make learning fun.
mkt_translate_desc: Quickly look up words and short phrases, understand their meanings with context, and add them directly to your dictionary.
mkt_collections_desc: Access carefully curated vocabulary collections across diverse themes and levels to start learning immediately.
mkt_offline_desc: Access your vocabulary lists and games anywhere, anytime, even without an active internet connection.
footer_slogan: Build your dictionaries, play word games, master vocabulary.
